candidates.change_summary: Replace the addition assignment to subtract the incoming msg.value instead of adding it, causing balances to decrease when funds are sent in.
Change getBalance to return userBalance[u] + 1 instead of the stored balance, causing a different returned value.
Removed the overflow-guarding require check so addToBalance no longer reverts on the unlikely overflow condition.
Invert the require condition to revert when the usual non-overflow condition holds, causing most calls to revert and leaving balance unchanged.
Change addition target to a different mapping key (address(0)) so funds are credited to a fixed address instead of the sender.
Neglect to add msg.value and instead set the sender's balance to msg.value, replacing accumulation with overwrite.
